description: Slovakia RPVS Beneficial Owners (UBO) Scraper. Search Slovakia's public beneficial-ownership register (RPVS) by IČO or company name. Returns beneficial owners with a public-official (PEP) flag, plus the authorised person. No API key. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

currentOnly.description: Off (default): include historical beneficial owners and identities. On: keep only currently-valid entries.
currentOnly.title: Current entries only

exactMatch.description: Off (default): contains-search. On: match the company name exactly.
exactMatch.title: Exact name match

icoNumbers.description: One or more Slovak IČO registration numbers (e.g. "35763469"). Used when search mode is "By IČO".
icoNumbers.title: IČO numbers

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

maxResults.description: Maximum partner records to export across all queries.
maxResults.title: Max results

searchMode.description: Look up by Slovak company registration number (IČO), or search by company name.
searchMode.title: Search mode

searchQuery.description: Company name to search (contains-match on the partner's registered name). Used when search mode is "By company name".
searchQuery.title: Company name

name: regdata_slovakia_rpvs_ubo
